Class VirtualView

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.VirtualView
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateObserver
Direct Known Subclasses:
RMIClientHandler, SocketClientHandler
public abstract class VirtualView extends Object implements GameStateObserver
Base class for network-facing views that observe the game state and relay events to clients.
